Can you articulate in your commit message why we need a separate API for this?  There's already a WriteFru API that would let you add a section easily.

Can you walk through what a normal workflow for using this would be? (including the external facing APIs).

I would normally expect that someone would use the WriteFRU command to add whatever they liked to the FRU, if they're going to use IPMI specifics to do it.  They generally will use the parsed fields for interacting with individual fields.
Can this callback be a separate function. Because the function addFruObjectToDbus is already long we can avoid adding too much code here.
I kept it as it because we are calling only one function here & no much processing.
